data.name: Tersina
data.gender_notes: Tersina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Tersina was a nymph who personified the fertile earth. Her name is derived from the Greek word 'teras' meaning harvest. Tersina was believed to protect and nurture crops, ensuring a bountiful harvest for her people. The name Tersina carries the meaning “Harvester of the earth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tersina usually hope their child will grow to embody harvester of the earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of abundance and fertility, Tersina embodies the nurturing and life-giving qualities of the earth.
data.etymology: Tersina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Harvester of the earth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tersina total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

Ultimately, the name 'Tersina' invites us to embrace the fullness of life, both materially and spiritually, and to live daily with joy, purpose, and gratitude.
